notes: The partitive of on the fronted marked object is given to the object marker under rule 16's subtraction test, since nothing but the object relation is diminished by dropping it; reading the of as added instead is the competing analysis and is named in the unit's note.
The closing marker takes for, the preposition through which the recast English verb reaches its object (rule 16's first family).
Three waws against one and: only the waw joining the tens and units is rendered (rule 42).
The italic shekels supplies a measure noun the Hebrew never writes and is added (rule 33's limit).
